description: a vertical cylinder (radius 1, z 0..3, on x = 5) fused with a horizontal one (radius 1, axis along x from -6 to 6 at z = 3) whose end disc, in x = 6, is tangent to the vertical wall along x = 6, y = 0, z in 2..3. The vertical cylinder's part inside the horizontal one has height sqrt(1 - y^2) over its disc, so the overlap is the integral over y of 2 (1 - y^2), 8/3: V = 3 pi + 12 pi - 8/3 = 15 pi - 8/3, A = 33 pi - 8. Arris faults with a cycle of the end disc's arrangement that does not turn once (SplitFault::Turn); a longer cylinder (14) builds. The desired result is Full-green (plans/tangency-faults step 5)

probes.label: horizontal cylinder over the vertical one

analytic.occt_odd_euler: Open CASCADE carries the touching ruling as an edge of four faces, so its shape has an odd Euler characteristic
